questions.question: Sapna invest 18% of her monthly income in mutual funds. If she invests Rs. 5,724 in mutual funds, what is her monthly income?
questions.solution:
Let, Sapna's monthly income is Rs. 100

Given information,

Sapna invests her monthly income in mutual Fund = 18%

And she invests in mutual funds = Rs. 5,724

Then,

18% = 5,724

1% = 5,724 / 18

1% = 318

Now, 100% = 318 x 100 = 31,800

So,** Sapna's monthly income will be 31,800.**

Hence, **"31800"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two digits should be interchanged on the left hand side of the equal sign to make the given equation correct?

596 - 125 ÷ 19 + 65 × 2 = 598
questions.solution:
Given equation is :

596 - 125 ÷ 19 + 65 × 2 = 598

(i) 596 - 125 ÷ 19 + 65 × 2 = 598

Interchanging **9 and 6 **on the left hand side of the equation and applying** BODMAS** rule,

569 - 125 ÷ 16 + 95 × 2 = 598

569 - 7.8125 + 95 × 2 = 598

569 - 7.8125 + 190 = 598

759 - 7.8125 = 598

751.1875

**LHS ****≠ RHS.**

(ii) 596 - 125 ÷ 19 + 65 × 2 = 598

Interchanging **1** and 9 on the left hand side of the equation and applying BODMAS rule,

516 - 125 ÷ 91 + 65 × 2 = 598

516 - 1.3736 + 65 × 2 = 598

516 - 1.3736 + 130 = 598

646 - 1.3736 = 598

644.6264 ≠ 598

LHS ≠ RHS.

(iii) 596 - 125 ÷ 19 + 65 × 2 = 598

Interchanging **5** and 6 on the left hand side of the equation and applying BODMAS rule,

695 - 126 ÷ 19 + 56 × 2 = 598

695 - 6.6316 + 56 × 2 = 598

695 - 6.6316 + 112 = 598

807 - 6.6316 = 598

800.3684 ≠ 598

LHS ≠ RHS.

**(iv) 596 - 125 ÷ 19 + 65 × 2 = 598**

**Interchanging 2 and 5 on the left hand side of the equation and applying BODMAS rule,**

296 - 152 ÷ 19 + 62 × 5 = 598

296 - 8 + 62 × 5 = 598

296 - 8 + 310 = 598

606 - 8 = 598

598 = 598

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"2 and 5".**

questions.solution:

First number = (Second number)² - 1

Or,

Second number = √ (First number + 1)

For 24 : 5,

5 = √ (24 + 1)

5 = √ 25

5 = 5.

**For 48:?**

**? = √ (48 + 1)**

**? = √ 49**

**? = 7.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"7".**

questions.question: Sachin left his home and walked 60 m in the north direction. Then he took a 90° clockwise turn and walked 120 m to reach a shop. He then took a left turn and walked 30 m to reach his school. Find the shortest distance between his house and school.
questions.solution:
Representing the given information on **NESW :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5489686d05e22bc74ce20a95e29677db0b9d3b1f6ba102e66839c33607f4463.png] 

The shortest distance between home and school is OA.

AB = AC + CB

AB = 30 + 60

AB = 90 m.

OB = 120 m.

Applying **Pythagoras theorem **in ΔAOB :

(Hypotenuse)² = (Base)² + (Perpendicular)²

(AO)² = (BO)² + (AB)²

(AO)2 = 120² + 90²

(AO)2 = 14400 + 8100

(AO)2 = 22500

AO = √ 22500

AO = 150 m.

So, the shortest distance between home and school is 150 m.

Hence, the correct answer is **"150 m".**

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Identify which letter will appear on the face opposite to the face with the letter 'N'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d70ebe64b6fb333b8c888f10fb281ee7ccf23e25aca6e8ce7320982160efcf45.png]
questions.solution:
Taking dice positions 2 and 3 with P as common, moving in either clockwise or anticlockwise direction, we get

Pair of opposite letters :

P - Q

**O - N**

M - L

**So, the opposite letter to N is O.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"O".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

Taking positions 1 and 3 in consideration : 

**L ** is the common letter in both dice.

L is on the **Front face **of both the dice.

So, **corresponding faces **will be opposite to each other.

Pair of opposite letters :

P - Q

**O - N**

Remaining L and M will be opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

When three positions of the same dice are given then we consider any two positions with one common.

Then we move either in clockwise or anti-clockwise direction from the common letter.

In this way, we get the pairs of opposite faces.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions number I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All diaries are books.

All page are diaries.

Conclusions:

I. All pages are books.

II. Some books are diaries.

III. All books are pages.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusion I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb58491f5f5c1005219cfbf4b94924c06f30f938bda1552b8a22b66152811d92.png] 

Conclusions:

1. All pages are books → True (It is clear from the given statement that all the pages are diaries and all the diaries are books so all pages are books will also be correct).

2. Some books are diaries → True (It is clear that all diaries are books, so some books are also diaries will be right).

3. All books are pages → False (It is clear that all pages are diaries and all the diaries are books but we can't say that all the books are pages it can be or cannot be because no direct relation is given from the book side).

Thus, **Only conclusion I and II follow.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

Suppose for an Example: All A are B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab79005e5895f30563c1890a00ef2f56cc4dd4037f4e73e5263bdadf4f935695.png] 

If we go from In to Out means from A to B then cases with All and some will be true like All A are B and Some A are B.

But if we go Out to In then only cases with Some will be true and All will be can't say like Some B are A will be true but All B are A will be can't say.

questions.question: The ratio of the ages of a mother and a daughter after 20 years will be 15 : 8 and the ration of their ages 8 years ago was 8 : 1. What is the ratio of their current ages?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of ages of a mother(M) and a daughter(D) after 20 years = 15 : 8

Ratio of ages of a mother(M) and a daughter(D) 8 years ago = 8 : 1

**Calculation:**

According to question,

(M + 20)/(D + 20) = 15/8

8 × (M + 20) = 15 × (D + 20)

8M + 160 = 15D + 300

8M – 15D = 300 – 160 

8M – 15D = 140 ----(i)

(M – 8)/(D – 8 ) = 8

M – 8 = 8 × (D – 8)

M – 8 = 8D – 64

M – 8D = 8 – 64

M – 8D = – 56 ----(ii)

After multiplying equation (ii) by 8 and subtracting it from equation (i), we get

8 × (M – 8D) – (8M – 15D) = 8 × (– 56) – 140 

8M – 64D – 8M + 15D = – 448 – 140 

– 49D = – 588 

D = 588 / 49 

D = 12

And M – 8D = – 56

M – 8 × 12 = – 56

M = 96 – 56 

M = 40

Ratio of their present ages = M/D = 40/12

∴ The ratio of their present ages is **10 : 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

 
 

 **Years**
 **Mother**
 **Daughter**
 
 

 +20
 15 : 8
 
 

 -8
 8 : 1
 
 

 **Difference**
 7 : 7
 
 

7 ratio = 20 + 8 = 28 years

So, 1 ratio = 28/7 = 4 years

The ratio of their present ages

15 × 4 - 20 : 8 × 4 - 20

⇒ 60 - 20 : 32- 20

⇒ 40 : 12 = 10 : 3

**∴ The ratio of their present ages is 10 : 3.**

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some fishes are whales.

No whale is a swimmer.

Conclusions:

I. All fishes are swimmers.

II. No fish is swimmer.

III. Some fishes are swimmers.

options.text: Either conclusion II or III follows
Both conclusions II and III follw

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follow :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/235a58d62f73ee9e4a9d46875cc52ad9b30fa106ea34fda1b2c0b2ffe83d5dd0.png] 

**Conclusions :**

I. All fishes are swimmers → False (There is no direct relation between fishes and swimmers given. So, it is not definite)

II. No fish is swimmer → False (There is no direct relation given between fish and swimmer. So, it is not definite)

III. Some fishes are swimmers → False (There is no direct relation given between fish and swimmer. So, it is not definite)

Also, Conclusion (2) and conclusion (3) form **complementary pairs.**

So, this is an **Either or **case.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Either conclusion II or III follows".**
